goal: 在/tmp 下面构建一个js的网页，用户输入，展示绚丽的动态效果

in_scope: Test in browser and verify effects

subtasks.title: Create HTML page structure
subtasks.description: Create /tmp/index.html with basic HTML5 structure, including a text input field for user input and a canvas/container div for dynamic effects. Include embedded style and script sections.

criteria.description: HTML file exists and renders in browser with visible input field

verifier.prompt: Evaluate whether the following acceptance criterion is met: "HTML file exists and renders in browser with visible input field". Respond with a score from 0.0 to 1.0.

subtasks.title: Add CSS styling and animations
subtasks.description: Add CSS for dark gradient background, styled input field with glow effects, and base animations. Include keyframe animations for pulsing, floating, and color transitions.

criteria.description: Page has visually appealing dark theme with glowing input field

verifier.prompt: Evaluate whether the following acceptance criterion is met: "Page has visually appealing dark theme with glowing input field". Respond with a score from 0.0 to 1.0.

subtasks.title: Implement particle effect system
subtasks.description: Create JavaScript particle system on canvas that responds to user input. Particles should spawn on text input, follow mouse movement, and have physics-based motion with gravity, velocity, and fade effects. Include multiple particle types (circles, stars, trails).

criteria.description: Typing in input field triggers colorful particle effects on canvas

verifier.prompt: Evaluate whether the following acceptance criterion is met: "Typing in input field triggers colorful particle effects on canvas". Respond with a score from 0.0 to 1.0.

subtasks.title: Add dynamic text visualization
subtasks.description: Implement visual effects for user's text input: each character appears with explosion effect, text floats upward with trail effects, and creates ripple/wave animations. Sync text display with particle bursts.

criteria.description: Typed characters appear with explosion/ripple effects and animate

verifier.prompt: Evaluate whether the following acceptance criterion is met: "Typed characters appear with explosion/ripple effects and animate". Respond with a score from 0.0 to 1.0.

subtasks.title: Add mouse and touch interactions
subtasks.description: Implement mouse/touch hover effects, click explosions, and drag trails. Add sound toggle option and color theme switcher for different effect styles (fire, ice, rainbow, galaxy).

criteria.description: Mouse movement and clicks create visual effects

verifier.prompt: Evaluate whether the following acceptance criterion is met: "Mouse movement and clicks create visual effects". Respond with a score from 0.0 to 1.0.
Evaluate whether the following acceptance criterion is met: "theme can be changed". Respond with a score from 0.0 to 1.0.

subtasks.title: Test in browser and verify effects
subtasks.description: Open the page in browser, test all interactions: typing in input field, mouse movements, clicks, theme switching. Verify performance is smooth (target 60fps). Check both desktop and mobile responsiveness.

criteria.description: Page works in browser with smooth animations and all interactions functional

verifier.prompt: Evaluate whether the following acceptance criterion is met: "Page works in browser with smooth animations and all interactions functional". Respond with a score from 0.0 to 1.0.
